description: The forwarding floor: a counter of pigeonholes and airway-bill stamps, a scale bolted to the deck, and a wall map of routes nobody flies anymore. A dead conveyor runs out through a rubber-flapped hatch toward the aprons.

window.description: A window set too high in the wall to see the ground through, so it offers the sky and nothing else. On a bad day that's more information than you want.
window.name: the high window

name: Airfreight Forwarding
